paragraphs: Rav Yaakov, son of Rav Acha bar Yaakov.

It is told in Kiddushin 29b that his father sent him to study before Abaye. When he [the son] came [back], he [the father] saw that his learning was not sharp, and said to him: I am better than you; rather, you sit at home and I will go to study, etc.
